description: Lists the fertilizer product slugs this API tracks (anhydrous ammonia, urea, DAP, MAP, potash, liquid N 28/32, ATS, farm diesel, biodiesel) with display labels. Use to discover valid `product` values before calling get_fertilizer_price or get_fertilizer_history. Read-only; no API key. The list is the configured catalog across the tracked MARS production cost reports, not a live availability check.
name: list_fertilizer_products
